case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised the hotel's central location and friendly, helpful staff; several noted cleanliness and an adequate breakfast. Reviewers reported variability in room condition—top-floor rooms renovated while others felt old or dilapidated—with complaints about small or uncomfortable beds, a sinking sofa mattress, dated or slippery bathrooms, a report of no power outlets, stairs/no elevator and occasional late‑night guest noise.
